content.value_statement: React Native test setup and debugging can be difficult when teams lack clear examples. This skill provides focused Jest and React Native Testing Library patterns for common mobile testing tasks.
actual_capabilities: Sets up Jest and React Native Testing Library dependencies.
Provides component test examples for rendering and press events.
Shows hook and utility test patterns.
Explains mocks for notifications, databases, and navigation.
Lists commands for tests, watch mode, coverage, and snapshots.
Provides patterns for asynchronous UI, forms, and lists.
limitations: It does not run tests or modify project files by itself.
Examples may require adjustment for a project configuration.
It does not cover end-to-end testing frameworks or device automation.
It does not diagnose failures without test output and project context.

use_cases.title: Start a component test suite
use_cases.description: Set up Jest and write initial rendering and interaction tests for a React Native screen.

use_cases.title: Test application logic
use_cases.description: Create focused tests for hooks and utility functions, including invalid input handling.

use_cases.title: Resolve unreliable tests
use_cases.description: Apply mock, async query, and debugging guidance to investigate failing or timing-out tests.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic component test
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Jest test for my React Native Button component. Test that its title renders and its onPress callback runs.

prompt_templates.title: Test a custom hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a React Native Testing Library test for my useCounter hook. It should verify the initial count and increment behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Mock a dependency
prompt_templates.prompt: Show how to mock expo-router in my React Native Jest test. My component calls router.push after a button press.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate an async failure
prompt_templates.prompt: My React Native test times out while waiting for loaded content. Review this test output and suggest a stable async testing approach.

output_examples.input: Create a test for a login form that rejects an invalid email address.
output: A focused test outline that enters an invalid email address.
A submission step using a test identifier.
An assertion that confirms the validation message appears.

output_examples.input: How do I run coverage for my React Native tests?
output: Run the coverage test script with Jest coverage enabled.
Review uncovered lines and add behavior-focused tests before relying on the percentage.

best_practices: Test user-visible behavior instead of implementation details.
Use stable test identifiers for important interactive elements.
Mock external dependencies to keep unit tests isolated and predictable.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on arbitrary delays when async queries can wait for UI changes.
Do not test private component state or internal implementation details.
Do not share mutable mock state between tests without resetting it.

faq.question: Which testing libraries does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Jest and React Native Testing Library patterns for React Native applications.

faq.question: Can this skill install dependencies?
faq.answer: It provides the installation command, but it does not install packages by itself.

faq.question: Does it include end-to-end testing?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on unit and component testing rather than device-based end-to-end testing.

faq.question: How can I test a button press?
faq.answer: Render the component, locate the button, trigger a press event, and assert the expected callback or UI change.

faq.question: How should I handle asynchronous UI?
faq.answer: Use async queries such as findByText or waitFor instead of fixed delays.

faq.question: Can I mock navigation and services?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide includes examples for navigation, notification modules, and database clients.
